title: Tour: Main pane
preconditions: the main window is 1440 x 900 pt
the launch has one workspace with one terminal (an empty saved session)

expect.noReceiptReason: a tour step: the bundle's cmux prints no ActionEffect kind (driver_app.py op_cli)

steps.note: the tour launches with this setting; case-v1 has no launch config

expect.noReceiptReason: a tour step: the bundle's cmux prints no ActionEffect kind (driver_app.py op_cli)

invariants: each step's settled snapshot is the model state of the tour's picture of that step
no step waits on a clock: each ends on its waitFor value or the settle barrier
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: pixels: the tour's screenshots and video (scripts/cmux-next/media/tour.py); a case compares model state, and its reviewed baseline stands in for each picture

tour step 3 (An agent chat docks left, the terminal sits on its right): `cmux agent new-chat` is no CLI verb (cmux-tui cli/command.rs parse_agent sends it to agent_focus, a usage error), so the step fails on every build
tour step 4 (Focus the terminal column): it acts on the chat column the dropped agent new-chat step opens

tour step 5 (Closing the right column gives the chat its full width): tour.py optional (closing the terminal asked to confirm): its outcome on the bench build is not known, and a case step expects one outcome
tour step 6 (Focus the chat): it acts on the chat column the dropped agent new-chat step opens

tour step 7 (A link clicked in the lone chat: the chat docks left and the page slides in on its right): debug.terminal.links: CmuxNextApp/DebugTerminalLinks.swift registers it in DEBUG builds only, and the tours suite runs the bench build
tour step 8 (Focus the chat again): it acts on the column a dropped debug.terminal.links step opens

tour step 9 (A second link opens as a tab in the same right column): debug.terminal.links: CmuxNextApp/DebugTerminalLinks.swift registers it in DEBUG builds only, and the tours suite runs the bench build
tour step 10 (Closing the right column again: the chat is full width): it acts on the column a dropped debug.terminal.links step opens
tour step 11 (Main pane off (Debug override): a link from the chat opens in the chat's own pane): it only sets up the dropped debug.terminal.links step after it
tour step 12 (Focus the chat): it only sets up the dropped debug.terminal.links step after it

tour step 13 (With main pane off, the link is a tab in the chat's pane): debug.terminal.links: CmuxNextApp/DebugTerminalLinks.swift registers it in DEBUG builds only, and the tours suite runs the bench build
